subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Should WhatsApp CTWA attribution data be exposed only to opted-in plugin hooks, also to per-turn untrusted agent context, or persisted as session metadata for later Conversions API use?
rationale: The extraction is technically bounded, but `ctwaClid` is an ad attribution identifier and the issue asks for prompt and possible session exposure, so automation should not choose the visibility and retention boundary.

options.title: Expose via plugin hook
options.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned CTWA attribution payload for opted-in plugin hooks so a Conversions API plugin can consume it without automatically putting the identifier into every agent prompt or core session state.

options.title: Expose per turn only
options.body: Extract the CTWA fields into existing untrusted structured context for the current turn and avoid durable persistence.

options.title: Persist session attribution
options.body: Store the first CTWA payload on session state only after adding an explicit retention, redaction, and access policy.

recommendation.title: Expose via plugin hook
recommendation.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned CTWA attribution payload for opted-in plugin hooks so a Conversions API plugin can consume it without automatically putting the identifier into every agent prompt or core session state.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent current-main history owns the exact WhatsApp extraction, context forwarding, prompt rendering, and session metadata paths involved in the boundary decision.
